stories.title: This tiny cybersecurity startup managed to hack OpenAI using Claude, and won a $6,500 bounty
stories.sum: Hacktron, an SF-based startup, flagged vulnerabilities in OpenAI's systems and was paid $6,500 for the discovery.

stories.title: Homme Plissé Issey Miyake reimagines Matisse’s ‘The Snail’ at London’s Tate Modern
stories.sum: The latest chapter of Homme Plissé Issey Miyake’s Open Studio saw the Japanese label draw on Matisse’s ‘The Snail’ for inspiration, with help from Studio Dennis Vanderbroeck and the Dresden Frankfurt Dance Company

stories.title: United States Repatriates 58 Cultural Artifacts to China
stories.sum: A handover ceremony was held by the Chinese Embassy in Washington, DC, on Wednesday.

stories.title: New Lawsuits in Ongoing Battle Around Return of Nazi-Looted Art
stories.sum: Two new lawsuits, filed in Los Angeles Superior Court on Monday, by Jewish heirs or their representatives seek the return of artwork taken by the Nazis during World War II and now held by prominent museums.

stories.title: Sotheby’s Paris To Sell Schlumberger Collection Led By €30 Million Monet
stories.sum: Sotheby’s Paris has unveiled Le Temps Retrouvé, its title for a collection of Impressionist and Modern works that ranks among the most significant private groupings of its kind ever to be offered at auction in France.

stories.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping the “largest theft of labor in human history”
stories.sum: Microsoft, OpenAI emails reveal fear of AI “doom loop” killing news orgs.

stories.title: A.I. Agents as ‘Co-Scientists’? This Lab Says They Could Speed Drug Research.
stories.sum: A.I. is already a powerful tool for scientific discovery. Now, some biomedical researchers are teaching it to do even more.

stories.title: OpenAI reveals six more safety issues and unveils plan to disclose incidents
stories.sum: The firm also announced a new system to track, investigate and disclose cases of models misbehaving, or "misalignment".

stories.title: The 'Godfather of AI' backs a new watchdog plan to track OpenAI and Anthropic's AI risks from the inside
stories.sum: Anthropic and OpenAI said they'd welcome evaluators to track AI risks. A group of watchdogs, backed by pioneers like Geoffrey Hinton, has its answer.

stories.title: EU chief proposes sweeping social media ban for under-13s to protect children online
stories.sum: Ursula von der Leyen wants social media to be banned for under-13s across Europe

stories.title: OpenAI’s listing delay raises stakes for SoftBank’s $50bn data centre IPO
stories.sum: Initial public offering of SB Energy set to test investor appetite for Masayoshi Son’s AI gamble

stories.title: UAE, Sweden Arrest Seven Over $7.1M Crypto Laundering Ring Linked to Contract Killings
stories.sum: Investigators say tracing the network's crypto transactions exposed links to organized crime and murder-for-hire.

stories.title: Rodrigo Cass, Brazilian Artist Who Strove for ‘Sensitive Geometry,’ Has Died at 43
stories.sum: His gallery said that he died in a fatal accident in Rio de Janeiro.

stories.title: Houston’s Insiders Say the City’s Cultural Scene Remains One of the Art World’s Best-Kept Secrets
stories.sum: "Houston is a city of transplants, and I think that constant influx makes the cultural fabric richer," dealer Laura Burton told Observer.

stories.title: Filipino Artists’ Collective Protests ‘Devastating’ Impact of AI Hub
stories.sum: The AUPAX coalition of creatives is organising exhibitions, workshops and protests against the US‑helmed Pax Silica initiative, which has proposed an AI and manufacturing development on Luzon island.
